news.title: Consumer optimism slides to lowest since 2014 as fears escalate over rising prices and jobs
news.summary: The Conference Board's Consumer Confidence Index tumbled to 81.9, a decline of 6.7 points. The reading was well below the forecast for 89.

news.title: Property Play: Homeowners are sitting on record equity – and not using it
news.summary: U.S. homeowners have more housing wealth than ever before, thanks to fast-rising home prices. But they aren't spending much of it.

news.title: Trump Accounts will auto-enroll children, potentially adding 60 million accounts: Treasury
news.summary: The Treasury Department announced that Trump Accounts will begin auto enrolling eligible children. Here's what families need to know about how to apply for the accounts. The accounts will be available to children as well as adults.

news.title: Tech leaders arrive at White House for AI luncheon with Trump
news.summary: The artificial intelligence luncheon comes as calls for a slowdown and regulation reach a fever pitch. The luncheon is being held in Washington, D.C. on Wednesday.

news.title: Trump government ads were funded by Homeland Security, WSJ reports
news.summary: CBP funded government-paid Trump TV ads as Democratic appropriators say DHS dedicated $20 million to the campaign ahead of the midterm election.

news.title: Medicare Advantage plans will be cheaper next year. Here’s the new cost.
news.summary: Medicare beneficiaries can change their coverage during open enrollment. Open enrollment begins Oct. 15 and runs through Dec. 15. For more information, visit Medicare.gov/OpenEnrollment.

news.title: I’m 77, pay rent and live off Social Security, but I help homeless people. Why are so many people going hungry?
news.summary: “I am a retired senior citizen living check-to-check,” she says. “I’m not going to live in fear. I’ve been through a lot.”

news.title: Could SpaceX be worth $12 trillion one day? Citi says Starship gets it a step closer.
news.summary: The recent Starship launch helps SpaceX with a number of priorities that could help its stock reach $900 over the long run, an analyst says.

news.title: Here’s what Netflix skeptics are getting wrong about the stock, according to an analyst
news.summary: Deutsche Bank: Netflix investors are too worried about the U.S. Investors are overlooking gains abroad, Deutsche Bank argues. Netflix is one of the most popular streaming services in the world.

news.title: The hidden messages the bond market is sending about the AI boom and the stock market
news.summary: FT correspondent Robin Wigglesworth tells MarketWatch about how bonds build the modern financial system. She explains what they are currently saying about inflation, government debt and the financial markets.
